title: Big and Small — Comparing God's Creatures
memory_verse: "Ask the animals, and they will teach you." — Job 12:7
objective: Students will learn to compare sizes: big, small, tall, and short.
content: God made things in all different sizes! Some things are big and some things are small. An elephant is big. An ant is small. God made them both!
Some things are tall and some things are short. A giraffe is tall. A bunny is short. A tree is tall. A flower is short.
God made big oceans and small puddles. He made tall mountains and small hills. Everything God made is just the right size!
activity: Sort toys into big and small groups. Stand next to a friend — who is taller? Draw a big animal and a small animal.
discussion: What is a big animal God made?
What is a small animal God made?
